jobs.title: Payment Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Growe welcomes those who are excited to:

  • Decide how the hub behaves: make system behavior explicit (such as callback timeouts, withdrawal hold and release rules, gateway configuration setups, and player-facing error messages) rather than leaving these details in engineers' heads or partner systems;

  • Own the back office: drive and optimize the seven core operational screens used daily by internal teams (projects, gateways, payment groups, methods, orders, transactions, and logs) to ensure the hub remains fully usable;

  • Run discovery against internal systems: lead timeboxed spikes across eleven internal systems (including player accounts, wallet, KYC, fraud checks, reconciliation, and taxation) to rank findings by risk and resolve unknowns before they turn into rework;

  • Sequence the regional migration: define rollout stages, set validation rules using small percentages of live traffic and historical transaction replays, establish criteria for moving to the next step, and prepare clear rollback plans;

  • Keep regional teams aligned and informed: maintain strong trust and clear communication with local operations, support, and business owners regarding upcoming changes, potential risks, and contingency plans;

  • Plan for life after launch: establish operational processes for incident management, configuration changes, new method onboarding, and ongoing integration health once a region goes live.
We need your professional experience:

  • 4+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in payments, fintech, or complex transactional systems, holding ownership over a product area rather than just managing a backlog;

  • Ability to read API contracts and follow a transaction across multiple systems independently;

  • Proven track record of writing clear requirements, with explicit outcomes, clear acceptance criteria, and well-defined boundaries;

  • Data-driven approach to product decisions, working comfortably with conversion, approval rates, failure reasons, and cost per transaction to separate signal from noise;

  • At least Intermediate level of English for all documentation, ticketing, and daily cross-team communication.

We appreciate if you have those personal features:

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a knack for designing the smallest possible experiment to remove doubt when answers do not yet exist;

  • Strong sense of ownership and transparent communication, with the drive to inform affected regions early and plainly whenever something goes wrong;

  • Problem-solving skills - focus on reducing complexity, closing unknowns early, and preventing rework before development starts.

We are seeking those who align with our core values:

  • GROWE TOGETHER: Our team is our main asset. We work together and support each other to achieve our common goals;

  • DRIVE RESULT OVER PROCESS: We set ambitious, clear, measurable goals in line with our strategy and driving Growe to success;

  • BE READY FOR CHANGE: We see challenges as opportunities to grow and evolve. We adapt today to win tomorrow.

jobs.title: Supply Planning & Analytics Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

You will support network hardware demand and supply planning for a large cloud technology organization. This role focuses on evaluating weekly supply supportability, validating complex data, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring accurate reporting across the supply chain. You will collaborate with planning, sourcing, execution, and engineering stakeholders to improve reporting tools, strengthen planning processes, and provide clear insights that support business and technical decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Generate weekly demand, supply, and supportability reporting for network hardware.
  • Analyze week-over-week changes in demand, supply, and supportability.
  • Review source data, calculations, assumptions, and system outputs to identify discrepancies or errors.
  • Develop repeatable data-validation processes to maintain reporting accuracy.
  • Maintain documentation and traceability for changes, assumptions, processes, and reports.
  • Support weekly and monthly reporting of key performance indicators.
  • Improve existing planning processes, reports, and Power BI dashboards.
  • Partner with engineering teams to develop and enhance internal planning tools.
  • Build dashboards that communicate supply positions, constraints, gaps, and actionable insights.
  • Develop scenario-planning and “what-if” capabilities to support supply planning decisions.
  • Collaborate across demand planning, supply planning, component planning, sourcing, and execution functions.
  • Communicate findings, outstanding actions, and supportability updates to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Track follow-up items and ensure actions are completed accurately and on time.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain, operations, business, technology, manufacturing, sourcing, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in supply planning, operations, technology-related supply chain, manufacturing, sourcing, or a related function.
  • Strong supply planning experience, including demand and supply analysis.
  • 2–4 years of experience using AI-enabled analytics tools to automate data validation, generate insights, and improve reporting.
  • 2–4 years of advanced Excel experience.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and experience developing or optimizing business intelligence tools, including Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to identify data discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate with and influence both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and follow through on outstanding actions.
  • Availability to work Pacific Time hours in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting network hardware, cloud infrastructure, or technology supply chains.
  • Experience with component planning or indirect supply planning.
  • Experience with Kusto or similar large-scale data-query platforms.
  • Experience leading continuous-improvement initiatives for supply planning processes and reporting.
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to build internal tools.
  • Experience productionizing Power BI dashboards and analytics solutions.
  • Experience developing scenario-planning or “what-if” tools.
  • Familiarity with generative AI assistants and AI-enabled business intelligence features.
  • Previous experience working within a large enterprise technology organization.
  • Self-starter with a resourceful, proactive approach and the ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $90,000 to $100,000 USD annually. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Remote, United States

This role may be performed remotely from within the United States and is intended for candidates based in the Eastern Time Zone. Candidates must be available to work standard business hours aligned with Eastern Time.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Autonomy Technical Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary

Are you a trained engineer who over the course of your career realized your talents included managing projects and people?  Do you have a passion for advanced technology and problem solving and love to get to the bottom of tough problems and orient teams to solve them? Do you want to make a difference in a company that is changing mobility?

May Mobility is looking for highly motivated, activated, and energetic technical project managers who can lead teams to solve some of the hardest problems in autonomous driving. Work will include: leading teams to deeply analyze and understand problems through data, clarifying fuzzy requirements and prioritizing competing technical tasks, assessing and aggressively mitigating risks, and detail oriented status tracking.  Technical project managers at May coordinate frequently and effectively across all company functions including autonomy, vehicle engineering, software, product, finance, and operations.

This opportunity is a hybrid role, where office work is located at May Mobility HQ in Ann Arbor, Michigan. Occasional travel may be required to operational sites.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Engineering, Computer Science or highly technical degree preferred
  • A minimum of 2+ years of prior experience as an engineer or other highly technical area.
  • A minimum of 2+ years experience with managing direct reports, mentoring and coaching
  • A minimum of 5+ years of technical project management experience including team management, project planning, status updating, and risk management. Ideally this experience is at least partially in fast pace research and development projects.
  • A high level of initiative and activation. Must be able to enthusiastically take on challenges, including those peripheral to core responsibilities when needed for project success.
  • Ability to clarify and document fuzzy requirements and challenges such that a project team can efficiently and effectively solve problems.
  • An ability to clearly and concisely communicate technical concepts including root cause analysis, technical challenges and their solutions, and results backed by data.
  • An ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical people and teams.
  • Understanding of software and hardware development life cycles, integration processes, and test/validation complexity

Desirable

  • Working level knowledge of the autonomous vehicle industry
  • 7+ years of Project / Program management experience
  • 5+ years experience with managing direct reports, mentoring and coaching
  • Start-up experience

Physical Requirements

  • Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to:

    • Prolonged sitting
    • Prolonged standing
    • Prolonged computer use
    • Lift up to 50 pounds

  • Hybrid role based out of Ann Arbor, MI

    • Hybrid employees work remotely from their home or alternative work space as well as from one of our offices or sites at an agreed upon cadence set by their leader and based on the nature of their role. _ number of days per week/month or as otherwise agreed to with manager

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive healthcare suite including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans. Domestic partners who have been residing together at least one year are also eligible to participate.
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.
  • Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.
  • Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.
  • Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.
  • Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing

You may be the perfect candidate for this or another role at May.

Want to learn more about our culture & benefits? Check out our website!

You are cognizant of how all the pieces need to come together for successful program execution and can turn that into well-organized roadmaps, schedules, and budgets that you then track throughout the program lifecycle. You will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring successful execution of Muon’s contracts that you manage. You will support business development through proposals, RFI responses, customer engagement, and organic growth.

This role is based in San Jose with a hybrid schedule (3 days per week in-office), but may be worked remotely from an approved location.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a multidisciplinary aerospace development effort, driving day-to-day execution of the program
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to plan and coordinate the resources necessary to execute the program
  • Synchronize a diverse technical team by establishing tools, practices, and process

Nice-to-have Skills

jobs.title: Senior Product Delivery Manager (remote, Bulgaria) - Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours.
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

About Sutherland:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description

About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
